S.FORM: hayzani 'aehae' ka mae'iyaeh kamamanraan 'am rokrok ka boway sa'oewaz o 'am rokrok ka boway.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]ani ʔæhæʔ ka mæʔijæh kamamanraan ʔam rokrok ka βowaj [s|θ]aʔœwa[z|ð] o ʔam rokrok ka βowaj
S.FORM: hayzani 'aehae' ka mae'iyaeh kamamanraan 'am rokrok ka boway sa'oewaz o 'am rokrok ka boway.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]ani ʔæhæʔ ka mæʔijæh kamamanraan ʔam rokrok ka βowaj [s|θ]aʔœwa[z|ð] o ʔam rokrok ka βowaj
S.TRANSL: 現在有一個男人摘水果.
Now there was a man picking fruits.

S.FORM: mwai' 'aehae' mae'iyaeh ka 'ima hoehoe ka 'a Siri'.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ ʔæhæʔ mæʔijæh ka ʔima hœhœ ka ʔa ʃiriʔ
S.FORM: mwai' 'aehae' mae'iyaeh ka 'ima hoehoe ka 'a Siri'.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ ʔæhæʔ mæʔijæh ka ʔima hœhœ ka ʔa ʃiriʔ
S.TRANSL: 來了一個拉著山羊的人.
(There) came a person pulling a goat.

S.FORM: may isason ray kaehoey pingi'.
S.PHON: maj i[s|θ]a[s|θ]on raj kæhœj piŋiʔ
S.FORM: may isason ray kaehoey pingi'.
S.PHON: maj i[s|θ]a[s|θ]on raj kæhœj piŋiʔ
S.TRANSL: (他)經過那個樹下面.
(He) passed by there under the tree.

S.FORM: naw koSa'en bo boway bilis sahpih.
S.PHON: naw koʃaʔən βo βowaj βili[s|θ] [s|θ]ahpih
S.FORM: naw koSa'en bo boway bilis sahpih.
S.PHON: naw koʃaʔən βo βowaj βili[s|θ] [s|θ]ahpih
S.TRANSL: (那個男人)碰了一下水果然後走了.
(The man) touched the fruits and went away.

FORM.notes: source note: ka-papama'-an 車輛 vehicle | source note: KA-ride-NMZ | source note: KA-乘坐-NMZ | source note: 說這句時, informant 用手勢比腳, 所以應該加上noka 'a'ay, "with the feet" | source note: Note: Informant gestures with feet, so requires noka 'a' ay

S.FORM: mwai' 'aehae' ka 'a korkoring hiya' hayza koSa'en ka kapapama'an noka mae'iyaeh a sarak nak hini.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ ʔæhæʔ ka ʔa korkoriŋ hijaʔ haj[z|ð]a koʃaʔən ka kapapamaʔan noka mæʔijæh a [s|θ]arak nak hini
S.FORM: mwai' 'aehae' ka 'a korkoring hiya' hayza koSa'en ka kapapama'an noka mae'iyaeh a sarak nak hini.
S.PHON: mwaiʔ ʔæhæʔ ka ʔa korkoriŋ hijaʔ haj[z|ð]a koʃaʔən ka kapapamaʔan noka mæʔijæh a [s|θ]arak nak hini
S.TRANSL: 來了一個騎腳踏車的小孩, 就像這樣踩
(There) came a child riding a vehicle which you stomp like this.

S.FORM: sa saksakosiza sararakis.
S.PHON: [s|θ]a [s|θ]ak[s|θ]ako[s|θ]i[z|ð]a [s|θ]araraki[s|θ]
S.FORM: sa saksakosiza sararakis.
S.PHON: [s|θ]a [s|θ]ak[s|θ]ako[s|θ]i[z|ð]a [s|θ]araraki[s|θ]
S.TRANSL: (那個男孩)東張西望往上看(那個男人).
(The boy) looked around and upward (to the man).

S.FORM: 'aehae' koSa'en ka kamamanraan m rokrok ka boway 'okay sahae'oe.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən ka kamamanraan m rokrok ka βowaj ʔokaj [s|θ]ahæʔœ
S.FORM: 'aehae' koSa'en ka kamamanraan m rokrok ka boway 'okay sahae'oe.
S.PHON: ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən ka kamamanraan m rokrok ka βowaj ʔokaj [s|θ]ahæʔœ
S.TRANSL: 摘水果的人沒有往下看.
The man picking fruits did not look downward.

S.FORM: a noka a korkoring sikarma' 'aehae' koSa'en kala' ka 'a boway pama'en ila.
S.PHON: a noka a korkoriŋ [s|θ]ikarmaʔ ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən kalaʔ ka ʔa βowaj pamaʔən ila
S.FORM: a noka a korkoring sikarma' 'aehae' koSa'en kala' ka 'a boway pama'en ila.
S.PHON: a noka a korkoriŋ [s|θ]ikarmaʔ ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən kalaʔ ka ʔa βowaj pamaʔən ila
S.TRANSL: 小孩偷了一籃, 載走了.
The child took away one basket and rode off.

S.FORM: sipanraan 'ita' koSaen ka tinawa'an batbato'an ki hinghae'.
S.PHON: [s|θ]ipanraan ʔitaʔ koʃæn ka tinawaʔan βatβatoʔan ki hiŋhæʔ
S.FORM: sipanraan 'ita' koSaen ka tinawa'an batbato'an ki hinghae'.
S.PHON: [s|θ]ipanraan ʔitaʔ koʃæn ka tinawaʔan βatβatoʔan ki hiŋhæʔ
S.TRANSL: (小孩騎著它的腳踏車)經過一條石頭路.
(The child rode his bike) through a stony road.

S.FORM: a mwai' naehaen 'aehae' koSa'en ka a kabinao' hinghae' ma papamaan nak hini koSa'en ka a nonak sarakan ka kapapama'an.
S.PHON: a mwaiʔ næhæn ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən ka a kaβinaoʔ hiŋhæʔ ma papamaan nak hini koʃaʔən ka a nonak [s|θ]arakan ka kapapamaʔan
S.FORM: a mwai' naehaen 'aehae' koSa'en ka a kabinao' hinghae' ma papamaan nak hini koSa'en ka a nonak sarakan ka kapapama'an.
S.PHON: a mwaiʔ næhæn ʔæhæʔ koʃaʔən ka a kaβinaoʔ hiŋhæʔ ma papamaan nak hini koʃaʔən ka a nonak [s|θ]arakan ka kapapamaʔan
S.TRANSL: 又來了一個女孩像這樣踩著腳踏車來.
(There) came a girl also riding a vehicle which you stomp like this.

FORM.notes: source note: 沒有跟對方說話或互相碰撞。Note: without talking or bumping into each other

S.FORM: hiza 'am kaklepiih rima' pon'aisin seiti' ka 'a tatpo' sahae' ila ray rai' ray raan isaa.
S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a ʔam kakləpiih rimaʔ ponʔai[s|θ]in [s|θ]əitiʔ ka ʔa tatpoʔ [s|θ]ahæʔ ila raj raiʔ raj raan i[s|θ]aa

S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a ʔam kakləpiih rimaʔ ponʔai[s|θ]in [s|θ]əitiʔ ka ʔa tatpoʔ [s|θ]ahæʔ ila raj raiʔ raj raan i[s|θ]aa
S.TRANSL: (他們兩個)在途中相遇, (其中一個)碰到帽子 (使得帽子)掉在地上.
(Both of them) met along the way; (one of them) touched the hat (causing it) to fall on the ground.

S.FORM: hiza kamamanraan korkoring hibih sakosizah.
S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a kamamanraan korkoriŋ hiβih [s|θ]ako[s|θ]i[z|ð]ah
S.FORM: hiza kamamanraan korkoring hibih sakosizah.
S.PHON: hi[z|ð]a kamamanraan korkoriŋ hiβih [s|θ]ako[s|θ]i[z|ð]ah
S.TRANSL: 男孩回頭看.
The child turned his head around and saw.

S.PHON: ni[s|θ]ia ka kapapamaʔan rima i[s|θ]aa [s|θ]ipatonoʔ ila raj ta malβən ila malβən hi[z|ð]a karmaʔ koʃaʔən ka ʔa βowaj ʔæhæʔ kalaʔ [s|θ]i[s|θ]aah ila raj ʔa tinawaʔan
S.FORM: nisia ka kapapama'an rima isaa sipatono' ila ray ta malben ila malben hiza karma' koSa'en ka 'a boway 'aehae' kala' sisaah ila ray 'a tinawa'an.
S.PHON: ni[s|θ]ia ka kapapamaʔan rima i[s|θ]aa [s|θ]ipatonoʔ ila raj ta malβən ila malβən hi[z|ð]a karmaʔ koʃaʔən ka ʔa βowaj ʔæhæʔ kalaʔ [s|θ]i[s|θ]aah ila raj ʔa tinawaʔan
S.TRANSL: 那籃(被男孩)偷走的水果掉到地上.
The basket of fruit that (the boy) had stolen fell on the ground.

S.FORM: hayza' mwai' sepat ka korkoring ta tatilhaehael rokrok hayza' ka boway.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]aʔ mwaiʔ [s|θ]əpat ka korkoriŋ ta tatilhæhæl rokrok haj[z|ð]aʔ ka βowaj
S.FORM: hayza' mwai' sepat ka korkoring ta tatilhaehael rokrok hayza' ka boway.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]aʔ mwaiʔ [s|θ]əpat ka korkoriŋ ta tatilhæhæl rokrok haj[z|ð]aʔ ka βowaj
S.TRANSL: 來了四個小孩幫忙撿水果.
Came four children who helped pick the fruits.

S.FORM: taboe'en naehaen ray kala' tatilhaehaelen sitil'itol 'askanen ray kapapama'an nisia.

S.FORM: taboe'en naehaen ray kala' tatilhaehaelen sitil'itol 'askanen ray kapapama'an nisia.
S.PHON: taβœʔən næhæn raj kalaʔ tatilhæhælən [s|θ]itilʔitol ʔa[s|θ]kanən raj kapapamaʔan ni[s|θ]ia
S.TRANSL: 放到籃子裡, 提起來, 放到腳踏車.
(They) put (the fruits) in the basket, lifted it, and put it on the bike.

S.PHON: ka manraan ila
S.FORM: ka manraan ila.
S.PHON: ka manraan ila
S.TRANSL: (男孩)走了.
(The boy) walked away.

S.FORM: manraan 'okik koza' 'oSa'an.
S.PHON: manraan ʔokik ko[z|ð]aʔ ʔoʃaʔan
S.TRANSL: (當那個男孩)沒有走多遠,
(When the boy) had not gone long/far,

S.FORM: nisia ka tatpo' haysia ray tinawa'an.

S.FORM: nisia ka tatpo' haysia ray tinawa'an.
S.PHON: ni[s|θ]ia ka tatpoʔ haj[s|θ]ia raj tinawaʔan
S.TRANSL: 他的帽子還在路上.
His hat was still on the ground.

S.FORM: hayza' too' sahoeroe' ka tatpo'.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]aʔ tooʔ [s|θ]ahœrœʔ ka tatpoʔ
S.FORM: hayza' too' sahoeroe' ka tatpo'.
S.PHON: haj[z|ð]aʔ tooʔ [s|θ]ahœrœʔ ka tatpoʔ
S.TRANSL: 有三個 ... (他們)找到帽子.
There were three... (they) found the hat.

S.FORM: mari'in nisia pal'is'isen pal'is'isen.
S.PHON: mariʔin ni[s|θ]ia palʔi[s|θ]ʔi[s|θ]ən palʔi[s|θ]ʔi[s|θ]ən
S.TRANSL: (有一個男孩)拿起(帽子)拍一拍, 拍乾淨.
(One of the boys) took (the hat and) shook it clean.

S.FORM: ta mintani' ila naehaen.
S.PHON: ta mintaniʔ ila næhæn
S.FORM: ta mintani' ila naehaen.
S.PHON: ta mintaniʔ ila næhæn
S.TRANSL: 那男孩停了一會兒.
"The boy stopped for a while.

S.FORM: sabowayen ila nisia ka 'a tatpo' sabowayen ka tatpo'.
S.PHON: [s|θ]aβowajən ila ni[s|θ]ia ka ʔa tatpoʔ [s|θ]aβowajən ka tatpoʔ
S.TRANSL: (一個男孩)走向 (那個小孩) 把帽子還給他.
(One of the boys) walked toward (the boy) and gave the hat (back to him).

S.FORM: isa mobay ila ka boway.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]a moβaj ila ka βowaj
S.TRANSL: (小孩)給(他們)水果.
(The boy) gave (them) fruit.

S.FORM: kayzaeh too' koSa'en ka 'a korkoring.

S.FORM: kayzaeh too' koSa'en ka 'a korkoring.
S.PHON: kaj[z|ð]æh tooʔ koʃaʔən ka ʔa korkoriŋ
S.TRANSL: 那三個小孩很好.
The three children were good.

S.FORM: 'ima manraan ila rihani' ma 'a rima' nakhini koSa'en makaksiyae' a si'ael ka boway.
S.PHON: ʔima manraan ila rihaniʔ ma ʔa rimaʔ nakhini koʃaʔən makak[s|θ]ijæʔ a [s|θ]iʔæl ka βowaj
S.TRANSL: (那些小孩)吃著水果高興的走了.
(The children) walked away happily eating the fruit.

S.FORM: manraan rima' may hiza ray kaehoey pingi'.

S.FORM: manraan rima' may hiza ray kaehoey pingi'.
S.PHON: manraan rimaʔ maj hi[z|ð]a raj kæhœj piŋiʔ
S.TRANSL: (他們)經過樹下面.
(They) walked away passing by under the tree.

S.FORM: isahiza ina rokrok koSa'en ka 'a boway hiza ray pingi'.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]ahi[z|ð]a ina rokrok koʃaʔən ka ʔa βowaj hi[z|ð]a raj piŋiʔ
S.FORM: isahiza ina rokrok koSa'en ka 'a boway hiza ray pingi'.
S.PHON: i[s|θ]ahi[z|ð]a ina rokrok koʃaʔən ka ʔa βowaj hi[z|ð]a raj piŋiʔ
S.TRANSL: (那個)摘水果的(男人)在樹下.
(The man) picking fruits (was) there under the tree.

S.FORM: sope ila.
S.PHON: [s|θ]opə ila
S.FORM: sope ila.
S.PHON: [s|θ]opə ila
S.TRANSL: (他)數 (籃子).
(He) counted (the baskets).

S.FORM: 'ampowa ila ma'an kaysa'an rokrok ka 'a boway.

S.FORM: 'ampowa ila ma'an kaysa'an rokrok ka 'a boway.
S.PHON: ʔampowa ila maʔan kaj[s|θ]aʔan rokrok ka ʔa βowaj
S.TRANSL: 怎麼了? 我剛剛摘的水果(哪裡去了)?
What's happened? (Where are) the fruits I just picked?

S.FORM: hawka' hini 'aehae' kala' a.
S.PHON: hawkaʔ hini ʔæhæʔ kalaʔ a
S.TRANSL: (他)不見了一籃.
(He) didn't see the (one) basket.

S.FORM: saksakosiza ila 'oka'i 'ikoSa karma'en haysani hayno' ila.
S.PHON: [s|θ]ak[s|θ]ako[s|θ]i[z|ð]a ila ʔokaʔi ʔikoʃa karmaʔən haj[s|θ]ani hajnoʔ ila
S.TRANSL: 他四下張望, 說, 被偷的那一籃現在在哪裡?
He turned around and said, 'where is the stolen (basket) now?'

S.TRANSL: 三個小孩把籃子藏在附近 我不知道在哪裡.
Three children have hidden (the basket) nearby. Where (I) don't know.

S.TRANSL: 他拿水果給他們一人一個.
He took one fruit for each one of them.

S.FORM: manraan 'am si'ael.
S.PHON: manraan ʔam [s|θ]iʔæl
S.TRANSL: 他們邊走邊吃.
Which they ate as they were on their way.

S.TRANSL: 我所看到的故事就到這裡.
(My story about) what I've seen ends here.
